checks.message: Official self_check_submission.py reports PASS and formal-review-ready for GitHub author Davdong2.
Provisional overall boundary is explicitly disclosed and used only for conceptual clipping and recalculation; official polygon is still required for statutory or precise use.
Three provisional key-area polygons are explicitly disclosed; announced areas are cited separately and content review remains eligible.
Spatial review passes schema validation, feature IDs, site containment, land-use coverage and non-overlap checks.
Static visual contains all required sections, matches known metric values and has no remote or active content.
Professional review passes all source, standard, depth, metric, matrix, scenario, key-area and risk evidence checks.
A3 booklet and A0 boards contain pages, embedded Chinese fonts and were raster-rendered for visual inspection.
Formal figures, OSM context and participant-cleared AI concept scenes have separate provenance and usage boundaries.
